dct_title_s: Descriptio fluminum Rheni, Vahalis et Mosae : a Rheno berca ad goricomium usque, comprehendens imperium Noviomagense, Batavium, Tielae et bomilii in sulas, regionesque conterminas.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; North oriented to the top on top map; north oriented to the top right corner on bottom map.; Shows the northern Rhine from Gorinchem, Netherlands to Wesel, Germany.; Does not match any states listed in Van der Krogt.; Copy differs only slightly from Van der Krogt's 3705:1.1 in that the wording in the publishing credit varies.; From the Appendix Atlas of the British Isles and Northern Europe, title created to represent a unique collection within the Clark Library, University of Michigan.
2 maps on 1 sheet sheet 45 x 54 cm
